divergences.summary: Candidate calls host vtable slots +0x08/+0x14 instead of retail +0x50/+0x94.
divergences.impact: Host Device7 abstraction only; argument order, argument count and execution order are preserved. This is not evidence that the host ABI matches DX7.

divergences.summary: GCC tail-merges mode 1 into the mode-2 tail, reducing static call sites and return sites.
divergences.retail: 23 call instructions (22 device + 1 Debug_Error), 3 returns, 8 blocks
divergences.candidate: 20 call instructions (19 device + 1 Error_Show), 2 returns, 10 blocks
divergences.impact: Static shape differs; per-mode execution sequence and the returned EAX are identical.
divergences.resolution: Verified by following the mode-1 jump at 0x1A3 into the shared TSS/0x17/0x0E tail and by comparing all three sequences.

divergences.summary: Fatal call is Error_Show rather than the Binary Ninja name Debug_Error.
divergences.impact: Same retail callee and same halt. Error_Show is variadic and may return, so the candidate's halt is what preserves the retail hang.
divergences.resolution: Call target and post-call hang match; the no-return property of retail Debug_Error is not statically proven.

limitations: Static comparison only. No runtime capture, no device-state observation and no FPS/frame comparison was performed.

The measured candidate is the pre-link COFF object from engine/src/retail/terrain/terrain_unknown_blendmode.cpp (sha256 457ff29a...), compiled with the recorded command. build-clean-win32/igi1.exe does not contain this TU (CMakeLists.txt:76-79 excludes it; the executable has no such symbol and its digest 691c0839... is recorded for build-state traceability only).

cfg_similarity 1.0 in this record is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 graph score. It is not a candidate score; the candidate is compared in this file at source/object level and that comparison is not reduced to a jaccard value.
The candidate's host vtable slots +0x08/+0x14 are not retail offsets. The comparison maps them by call shape; the record makes no claim that Device7's host layout equals DX7's.

GCC tail merging means static call-site counts (23 vs 20) and return-site counts (3 vs 2) differ while the per-mode execution sequence is identical. The equivalence claim covers only those three documented sequences, not arbitrary device-pointer aliasing.
Error_Show (retail 0x004AF7B0) is variadic and may return; the candidate still halts forever after the call. The retail Debug_Error's non-return cannot be proven statically.

The source provenance comment still carries the pre-comparison TRANSCRIBED label and its Tools/evidence lines are wrapped, so scripts/native_gate.py emits non-blocking provenance warnings (missing Behavior/CFG: and Status/limits: lines, comment/status disagreement). The comment was not edited to avoid changing the source digest that this comparison binds.

This record promotes to STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED on the strength of the structural comparison, not on the retail-image CFG score. The project's strict gate still requires a semantic-review report bound to this implementation digest and a live behavioral runner; neither exists for this TU, so a strict gate invocation remains blocked.

status_recommendation.rationale: Retail entry, ABI, dispatch order, per-mode call order/arguments/constants, fatal path and return value were recovered from instruction-level evidence and compared against the compiled candidate. Every difference found is a compiler or host-ABI artifact with a stated resolution; no unresolved behavioural divergence remains in the compared scope.
